alarm_ipc.layout: one preallocated in-place command/result mapping per alarm worker; a worker replaces COMMAND_READY payload with RESULT_READY payload in the same pinned slot
alarm_ipc.handle_equation: the exact acknowledged holder snapshot contains 4 mappings, 8 events, 24 cross-process object-handle entries, 4 control-handle entries, and 28 ready handles; startup bootstrap has 8 steady handles, child-process creation peaks at 14, final-object PRE_READY peaks at 51, holder-proof closure is 43, and normal committed TRIM/1 is 28; service_limits.max_worker_processes owns only ordinary worker process count
alarm_ipc.allocation: after valid TRII/1 and committed TRIC/1, the startup Job and suspended service/monitor exist before mappings/events; after identity TRBH/1 all four mappings and eight events are created and proven through final/close TRBH/1 before holder proof and the sole TRIM/1 attempt; every mapping starts with the exact 32-byte header from wire-format.v1.json; no alarm-path mapping, slot, event, queue, or incarnation growth is permitted after readiness
alarm_ipc.pin_rule: a claimed slot remains pinned through ACKED; POISONED has no normal exit; epoch advances only on ACKED to EMPTY; replacement allocation is forbidden until complete TRAR/1 recovery
alarm_ipc.full_behavior: persistent full commits PREDISPATCH_FAILED_LIMIT with FAILED_LIMIT immediately; live full commits PREDISPATCH_FAILED_LIMIT with FAILED immediately; neither claims a slot, waits, allocates, or gates peer dispatch
alarm_ipc.scan_order: the sole coordinator for a publisher claims the lowest-index EMPTY slot; the worker performs one bounded full scan and processes COMMAND_READY slots by alarm sequence then slot index; the mapping header is used only for freeze and stable-snapshot sequencing, never as a work index

startup_bootstrap.application_name: exact absolute executable path; never null
startup_bootstrap.raw_handle_text: exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters; zero, invalid, duplicate, malformed, or role-mismatched values reject before role work
startup_bootstrap.challenge_rule: four nonzero mutually distinct 32-byte BCryptGenRandom values
startup_bootstrap.inventory_freeze_rule: any byte change after acknowledged final inventory forbids TRIM/1
startup_bootstrap.holder_proof: after all eight bootstrap handles close: revalidate service then monitor GetProcessTimes identities, prove exact two-member Job, then call WaitForMultipleObjects once with [service,monitor], bWaitAll=FALSE, timeout=0; only WAIT_TIMEOUT 258 freezes the acknowledged 28-handle logical snapshot
startup_bootstrap.peer_loss_rule: pre-proof loss permits no TRIM/1 byte; post-proof loss cannot cancel, truncate, or suppress the unique TRIM/1 attempt, always returns TR-START-FAILED and permits no readiness, while a successful commit remains recovery authority

startup_authoritative_io.primitive: frozen bounded terminal-overlapped startup authority I/O
startup_authoritative_io.resource_rule: OVERLAPPED, event, buffer, and file handle remain owned until terminal completion; deadline requests cancellation but never authorizes early release
startup_authoritative_io.ordering: I03 delivers the coordinator entrypoint/state shell and sole TRII/1 call sites; I05 extends the same coordinator after TRII_SELECTED, resolves exact TRIC/1 a0/a1 paths through all 81 pairs, executes at most one table-selected create-new action at a time, and completes the selected TRIC/1 before Job, child, mapping, event, duplicate-handle, or ordinary-worker creation; TRIM/1 has exactly one post-holder-proof append attempt to that selected file; ordinary workers start only after matching committed TRIM/1
startup_authoritative_io.failure_rule: any non-positive, timeout-unknown, cancellation-unknown, reopen, readback, witness, access, or identity mismatch blocks the corresponding allocation/readiness gate

atomic_mapping_abi.buffer_rule: each call retains one writable C-contiguous Py_buffer and validates in-range naturally aligned address
atomic_mapping_abi.ordering_rule: MSVC full-fence Interlocked intrinsics may provide ordering stronger than acquire/release
atomic_mapping_abi.failure_rule: ABI, platform, width, alignment, range, overflow, underflow, or self-test mismatch blocks startup before mapping use

operations.name: INSTALLATION_AUTHORITY_ADOPTION
operations.effect: adopt already committed installation and IPC authority and open monitor journal state; no TRII/1, TRIC/1, or TRIM/1 path resolution, create, write, flush, witness, readback, reopen, or identity operation

large_payload_rule: Ordinary non-alarm commands or responses larger than their fixed mailbox use one bounded anonymous mapping described by fields 16..18 and only within an operation's matching profile response/input byte bound. Alarm operations never use this rule. The slot payload is a closed union: exact 512-byte TRAD/1 command, inline result at most 4096 bytes, or exact 512-byte TRAF/1. Larger known-session persistent results and every session-unknown persistent result use verified TRAF/1; no truncation, split, path-only result, or detached queue exists. Ordinary mapping handles close after result or fail-closed deadline; unproven closure poisons the worker and blocks dependent work.
alarm_static_validation: Reject unless every alarm IPC byte/object/handle/capacity term equals its semantically matching alarm_ipc_limits key, each mapping starts with the exact 32-byte atomic header, slot_bytes equals 256 plus 4096, all twelve states and the pinned lifecycle match wire-format.v1.json, mapping sizes recompute to 8736/8736/4456480/4456480 and aggregate 8930432, exact TRBH/1 and holder proof freeze all 28 acknowledged ready handles and access masks, creation boundaries equal 8/14/51/43/28, max concurrent incarnation equals one, and operations 12/13 use only TRAS/1 with no TLV or dynamic mapping.
alarm_role_control_rule: Alarm-role BOOTSTRAP and SHUTDOWN also use one TRAS/1 slot before readiness/after admission closes, with all-zero alarm_id and a bounded control payload. They never create a second mailbox.
validation_rule: The frame role must list the operation; request/result fields must match the exact required/optional set; all other fields, duplicate fields, oversized frames, stale operation IDs, wrong incarnations, and deadline-late commands are rejected before role work.
version_evolution: Role, operation, and field IDs are immutable for 1.0 after batch-010 review and user confirmation. Operation code 3 was renamed and narrowed by the reviewed C-001 plan amendment before implementation; any later change requires a reviewed plan amendment and new vectors.
